scope: Seasonal review corrections, natural snow, real Santa gait, multicolour fireworks, pinned hangers, shared rendering and scrolling cost

changes.layout: Header visibility no longer hides pinned objects in real roots or full-screen previews. No safe-area spacer added.
changes.rendering: GTA keys and winter baubles now use tiny native photo/thread layers plus bounded gravity pendulum; no SceneKit viewport in these roots.
changes.snowfall: Six alpha-preserving macro ice crystals, six sizes and depth variations, native compositor fall/drift/rotation, capped at 38 particles. Light contrast is baked once.
changes.settledSnow: One continuous irregular bank follows the upper capsule lip and rounded shoulders. Non-periodic seeded control points, sparse overhangs, one non-tiled photographic material. Two small cached rasters for accumulation.
changes.christmas: Legacy preset globe becomes tree with nine native garland lights; registered four-frame reindeer gallop/Santa hand movement crosses the viewport from lower-left to upper-right.
changes.newYear: Three staggered bursts, 54 saturated comet-head/trail textures; no increase in particle count. Low-opacity dots were rejected on actual device review.
changes.proMotion: CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone=true verified in built Release Info.plist. This enables higher-rate hints, not a promise of fixed 120fps.
changes.newsFeed: Only visible news rows are realized with LazyVStack; existing remote image decoding stays off main thread.
changes.network: Bounded retries of transient reads, exact-revision recognition on ambiguous own operation, private save skipped when unchanged. Conflicts and denied authority are not retried as internet failures.
changes.catalog: One quick card per known preset, existing IDs and private copies preserved. Known legacy names display in selected language. Derived upgrade IDs remain stable on clock ticks; explicit celebration off persists.
changes.privacy: No sensor samples or performance data uploaded; no new analytics collection.
changes.displayClock: Native photo and 3D ornament display links use system-default range. Timestamp gates retain 10–60Hz ornament work budgets; they no longer request a lower shared display frequency. SCN renderer permits the actual screen maximum.

sdk.scope: Same unchanged repository implementation; actual Auth/Firestore SDK against loopback demo with production rules, private/public separation and denied admin/stale revisions.

physical.mode: Existing Serlest owner; real server reads and LOCAL previews only; no scene enable/save/publication.

burstTiming.observed: Colours present but dots too faint at real size; replaced with saturated comet heads and tails in build 143.

finalFollowup.scope: Winter scroll after separating work budget from display clock; bright multicolour streaks in both appearances.
finalFollowup.observed: Saturated streaks visibly rendered in light and dark frames; callback work budget uses system display clock.

physical.restore: Final ordinary app launch, no transient arguments; test teardown restored portrait. Test runner removed; UAC/account and personal data retained.

deviceStorage.state: Resolved by user. Clean baseline and targeted timing tests succeeded afterward; generated UI-test runner removed again at end.
deviceStorage.error: iOS installcoordinationd reports 0 bytes available when staging test runner
deviceStorage.cleanup: Only the generated UAC UI-test runner was removed; its data was 94618 bytes, installed binary about 11 MiB. Main UAC and personal data retained.
deviceStorage.next: Read back final retry result; no unrelated data deleted.

warnings.existingUnchangedSource: DirectoryEditorAccessStore.swift:50, generic Decodable actor-isolation warning in Release. No error; this unrelated source was not modified.
warnings.tooling: Xcode 27.1 metadata warning invalidDigitCount for iOS 27.2; functional device tests did execute.

performance.comparisonLimits: Exploratory repeated device scrolls with live feed and warm images; memory reduction is not proof of a guaranteed frame rate.
performance.traceUnavailable: Animation Hitches exported no frame/hitch rows for this device/tooling pair; it is not evidence of zero hitches. Simultaneous profiling interrupted the first 142 baseline measurement service; exclude it and rerun without profiler.
performance.framesCaveat: XCTest scroll metrics reported frame count zero alongside calculated FPS; do not present those values as a reliable measured 120Hz guarantee.

baselineAfterStorage.scope: Effects off. No simultaneous profiler. No exact FPS claim because frame-count counter is unsupported/zero.

finalWinter.note: Recorded CPU/memory and functional scroll results. OS signpost FPS is not accepted as a verified stable display rate because frame-count reports are zero; visible smoothness remains subject to user acceptance.
